title: ZK-Trace: Certified Collusion Tracing with Zero-Knowledge Credentials for Federated GNSS Interference Monitoring
abstract: arXiv:2609.08763v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Federated global navigation satellite system (GNSS) monitoring distributes a proprietary classifier to partly trusted stations, any of which may leak its copy. ZK-Trace combines public identity marks, recipient-specific Tardos fingerprints, and zero-knowledge credential verification. The registry supports offline tracing without the leaker's cooperation. We establish conditional false-accusation bounds for arbitrary recovered bit patterns, a finite completeness bound under a hidden-bias residual channel, and a deterministic tracing-score bound for correlated feature-distillation errors. An interval-arithmetic checker makes the conditional bound executable and allocates a common budget across accusation and tamper decisions. Under innocent-row independence, the certificate-based evaluation uses a false-naming budget of 0.001 per investigation. translated_title: ZK-Trace：基于零知识凭证的联邦式GNSS干扰监测认证合谋追踪
translated_abstract: 联邦式全球导航卫星系统（GNSS）监测将专有分类器分发给部分可信的站点，其中任何站点都可能泄露其副本。ZK-Trace 结合了公开身份标记、针对接收方的 Tardos 指纹以及零知识凭证验证。该注册表支持无需泄露者配合的离线追踪。我们为任意恢复的比特模式建立了条件性错误指控边界，在隐藏偏置残余信道下建立了有限完整性边界，并为相关的特征蒸馏错误建立了确定性追踪评分边界。区间算术检查器使条件边界可执行，并在指控与篡改决策之间分配共同预算。在无辜行独立性条件下，基于证书的评估在每次调查中使用 0.001 的错误指认预算。该方法隔离了全部 160 个单一所有者副本，并在 720 个双所有者混合样本中成功追踪 712 个，且未发生错误指认。
tldr: ZK-Trace 提出了一种融合公开身份标记、Tardos 指纹与零知识凭证验证的认证合谋追踪方案，能够在联邦式GNSS干扰监测中实现无需泄露者配合的离线追踪，并将每次调查的错误指控率控制在 0.001 以内。
en_tdlr: ZK-Trace combines public identity marks, recipient-specific Tardos fingerprints, and zero-knowledge credential verification to enable certified collusion tracing in federated GNSS interference monitoring, achieving offline tracing without the leaker's cooperation while keeping the false-accusation budget at 0.001 per investigation.
